chunks: (Moses) said: "This is (agreed) between you and me. Whichever term I fulfil, no injustice will be done to me. God is witness to our agreement."
ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to Pharaoh regarding their agreement and God's role as witness?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis as part of the dialogue between Moses (AS) and Pharaoh, highlights the concept of *ajal* (appointed term) as a divine guarantee of eventual justice. It underscores that despite Pharaoh's temporary dominance, the outcome is secured by Allah, who serves as the ultimate witness and guarantor of their covenant. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the inevitability of the truth prevailing over tyranny through divine timing.
